name: float_hash
note: review: FloatHashBasics pins infinities, NaN-by-identity, never -1 and hash(0.0) == hash(-0.0), so a version hashing every finite float to 0 passes; the exact modular rule (float-hash-numeric-tower) is open.

name: float_add
note: review: BinDispatch and the NaN/infinity clauses are now pinned, but for two finite operands AddIEEE only asks IsRounding (x + y) z plus a sign for an exact zero sum, and IsRounding does not fix the sign of an infinite result, so a float_add returning +inf for -1e308 + -1e308 passes.

name: float_sub
note: review: As for float_add: SubIEEE's finite clause is IsRounding (x - y) z plus the sign of an exact zero, and IsRounding leaves the sign of an overflowed result free, so a float_sub returning +inf for -1e308 - 1e308 passes.
